dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm so tired. We've been arguing about hunger for two hours.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm soʊ ˈtaɪərd. wiːv bɪn ˈɑːrɡjuːɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈhʌŋɡər fər ˈtuː ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There's no point arguing any more. Let's find something we all agree about.
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈpɔɪnt ˈɑːrɡjuːɪŋ ˈɛni ˈmɔːr. ˈlɛts ˈfaɪnd ˈsʌmθɪŋ wiː ˈɔːl əˈɡriː əˈbaʊt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. We all agree that hunger is a huge problem in many developing countries.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. wiː ˈɔːl əˈɡriː ðæt ˈhʌŋɡər ɪz ə ˈhjuːdʒ ˈprɑːbləm ɪn ˈmɛni dɪˈvɛləpɪŋ ˈkʌntriz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. But it's no use sending food aid only once. People need help every year.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bʌt ɪts ˈnoʊ ˈjuːs ˈsɛndɪŋ ˈfuːd ˈeɪd ˈoʊnli ˈwʌns. ˈpiːpəl ˈniːd ˈhɛlp ˈɛvri ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: True. They need help with their basic needs: food, clean water and healthcare.
dialogue.reading: ˈtruː. ðeɪ ˈniːd ˈhɛlp wɪð ðɛr ˈbeɪsɪk ˈniːdz: ˈfuːd, ˈkliːn ˈwɔːtər ənd ˈhɛlθkɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what about food waste? Rich countries throw away so much food.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈfuːd ˌweɪst? ˈrɪtʃ ˈkʌntriz ˈθroʊ əˈweɪ soʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is there any point talking about that here? It's a different problem.
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˈpɔɪnt ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðæt ˈhɪr? ɪts ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈprɑːbləm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think it's connected. If we wasted less food, more food could go to people who need it.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts kəˈnɛktɪd. ɪf wiː ˈweɪstɪd ˈlɛs ˈfuːd, ˈmɔːr ˈfuːd kʊd ˈɡoʊ tə ˈpiːpəl huː ˈniːd ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe. But it's no use telling people to waste less. They won't listen.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. bʌt ɪts ˈnoʊ ˈjuːs ˈtɛlɪŋ ˈpiːpəl tə ˈweɪst ˈlɛs. ðeɪ ˈwoʊnt ˈlɪsən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then supermarkets should give their extra food to charities.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪts ʃʊd ˈɡɪv ðɛr ˈɛkstrə ˈfuːd tə ˈtʃærətiz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a practical idea. Let's write it down.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈpræktɪkəl aɪˈdiːə. ˈlɛts ˈraɪt ɪt ˈdaʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. There's no point waiting. Let's start now.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈpɔɪnt ˈweɪtɪŋ. ˈlɛts ˈstɑːrt ˈnaʊ.
